points: After the year expired, at the time kings go to battle, Joab led the army, wasted the country of Ammon, and besieged Rabbah while David stayed at Jerusalem.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 20: The Fall of Rabbah and the Giants

points: Joab smote Rabbah and destroyed it; David took the crown of their king, a talent of gold set with precious stones, and it was set upon David's head.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 20: The Fall of Rabbah and the Giants

points: David brought out much spoil and set the people to labor with saws, iron implements, and axes, then all the people returned to Jerusalem.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 20: The Fall of Rabbah and the Giants

points: War arose again at Gezer with the Philistines, and Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, one of the children of the giant, and the Philistines were subdued.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 20: The Fall of Rabbah and the Giants

points: In another battle Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff was like a weaver's beam.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 20: The Fall of Rabbah and the Giants

points: At Gath a man of great stature with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot defied Israel, and Jonathan the son of Shimea, David's brother, slew him.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 20: The Fall of Rabbah and the Giants

points: These giants were born to the giant in Gath and fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
